classes.label: findings report/letter
classes.claim_power: official investigative findings, not person adjudication unless specific source text and state permit

classes.label: complaint
classes.claim_power: litigation allegation by filing party; not finding

classes.label: consent decree
classes.claim_power: court-approved obligations; admission language must be read exactly

classes.label: settlement agreement
classes.claim_power: agreement terms; not admission unless text says so

classes.label: monitor/compliance report
classes.claim_power: progress/status findings by monitor/evaluator; requires period and scope

classes.label: closing letter
classes.claim_power: agency matter closure statement; does not erase historical records

classes.label: court order
classes.claim_power: legal-status authority within scope of order

classes.label: statement of interest
classes.claim_power: DOJ legal position in another case; not a pattern-or-practice finding

classes.label: fact sheet/summary
classes.claim_power: secondary official summary; lower than underlying report/decree
